page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred closing lines and a woodcut ornament below; running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: fia magnus, eruditus, candidus, ortho-doxus, & orthodoxæ fidei insignis patronus, vt ab Hilario laudatus eft. Eum igitur adeant qui exactiora nosse desiderant.
Atque hæc hactenus de æterna Dei, solius sapientis, misericordis, iusti prædestinatione. Ei sit honor & benedictio in sæcula sæculorum Amen, &c.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (fruit and foliage with a central mask and ribbons) below FINIS, not transcribed. Scan shows show-through from the reverse page in the margins. Words "fia" and "exactiora" printed as shown; "fia" likely for "sia" (the line begins with a broken letter).
